_about: AUTHORED by the game team. Settings for the recorded narration (web/scripts/narration.ts, ElevenLabs). Choose one voice per language: run `npm run narration -- --voices` in web/ to list the voices of your ElevenLabs account, then put the voice_id and name here. A native Greek voice for el sounds much better than an English voice speaking Greek. 'say_as' changes how a word is pronounced in the recording only (the screen keeps the original): e.g. the project name ARGUS, which a Greek voice may otherwise spell out. Changing a voice, the model or the settings needs `--redo` to record everything again with them. Needs review: the pronunciation of ARGUS in Greek.
